answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in sparrow, expire in shale, and crystal lists each expiry. An farming party running 69 aliases therefore needs 181 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 52 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
